scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @asaas-lab/shared && npm run build -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @asaas-lab/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @asaas-lab/shared && npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @asaas-lab/shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @asaas-lab/shared && npm run test -w api
